response.justification: The candidate fails multiple critical mandatory requirements: only 6 months of documented C++ experience versus the required 5-10 years, no evidence of Windows platform development despite being explicitly mandatory, minimal SQL background, and zero capital markets or financial services domain exposure. While demonstrating strong software engineering fundamentals and excellent communication skills, the specialized technical depth and domain expertise required for this mid-senior capital markets role are fundamentally unmet.
strengths: Demonstrated expertise in software craftsmanship, TDD, and creating high-quality, testable systems across multiple technologies
Excellent verbal and written communication abilities, evidenced by conducted workshops, talks, and knowledge-sharing initiatives
Proven ability to learn new technologies and adapt across different programming languages and architectural domains
concerns: Only 6 months of C++ development experience documented (National Instruments 2014-2015), falling critically short of the mandatory 5-10 year requirement
No indication of Windows platform development experience; entire career trajectory focused on web, backend, and Linux-based technologies
Complete absence of capital markets, investment banking, fixed income, or any financial services domain exposure throughout career

key_factors.factor: C++ experience depth (6 months vs 5-10 years mandatory)
No capital markets or financial services domain expertise
Strong software engineering fundamentals and learning capability
